newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Sweden to sell Stadshypotek at best.
newsitem.headline: Sweden to sell Stadshypotek at best.

text.p: The Swedish government plans to sell the state's 34 percent stake in Stadshypotek to the highest bidder, Finance Minister Erik Asbrink said in a parliamentary budget debate.

"It will be the price that decides who may purchase the state's share in Stadshypotek," Asbrink said. "The sale will be done so as to benefit taxpayers in the best possible way, I want the best price possible."
Asbrink said that in disposing of the state's stake in Stadshypotek, Sweden's largest mortgage lender, the government would also consider the agency's competitive situation and its staff.
